title: Nonactionable native durable terminal outcome receipt
description: Closed nine-field local receipt, at most 4096 compact UTF-8 bytes. Actual producer returns it only after both exclusive files, file fsync, parent fsync and exact held/named readbacks finish within the original signed cleanup deadline. recordedBoottimeNs is sampled before marker publication and must be >= both retirement observations and < original cleanup bound; it is not a timestamp claiming when fsync completed. Scalar hashes alone do not prove custody or historical durability and authorize nothing.
